nodes.title: The three game laws are held by code (Games, claude/r8-laws-tally): server/forge3/qa/laws.mjs draws every family's real 2D view headless through the law's own acts (first screen, the first miss of each mal-rule while a try remains, the solve) and the play cert fails a cell on a break; tests/r8-play-laws runs it over every served (family, mode, goal) with a KNOWN list for main and the kon stream (docs/design/round8/games-judging/LAWS-AUDIT.md). Law 1 in the painter: a new focus token (blue-violet) for every selected body and every canvas 'you'; lime stays on the DOM action button only. Law 3 in the grade: a mal-rule signature on a goal in oneDecision or chancePicks (goal or goal:mal) is incorrect at CHANCE_WEIGHT with chanceMis and no misconceptionId; server/play/levels.js nameOnRepeat names it when the session sees it again from a pick on a level whose surface differs. Reverse if: a judged packet shows a green the checks passed (then the checks, not the judges, are wrong), or a child session shows a chance-pick mix-up that never gets a second, different-surface level to be named on (then serve the discriminating level sooner or name from the constructed act).

Laws audit over 107 served modes (930 levels, 2,958 screens, headless): before the fixes every family that selects drew the selection lime (45 views); 47 (goal, mix-up) pairs in 15 logics plus fair-test predict named a mix-up from one pick among 2 to 5; 6 views put green on a given or a truth (taraazu equation/equality first screen, fair-test predict meter, gati raftaar faster bar with a magnifier, gati tree, naap fever band, galti flagged-line note). After the fixes 16 modes still break: the science why-lines state the idea after a miss (aakash, badlaav aag, bhaap hawa, chhaano sukha, jaanch neela, rang, yantra roshni), aankde/tally prints the next try's totals, koshtak/tray open and kram/grow far print a key value, galti kaapi labels a line, and kon ends and place (for the kon stream).
